sources.researchNote: The distributor-supplied description gives “Released on: 2012-06-13”; YouTube publication is separately dated 20 November 2014. The structured date is the digital issue date, not a historical recording or film-production date. The album artwork and release metadata name Durbin but identify no original label, catalogue number, matrix or session. The digital “Music Publisher” field is not used to establish the historical sheet-music publisher.
